INSERT INTO build_events (workspace_id, step, status, message, progress)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid,
  'crawl', 'started', 'Fetching website content from {{ $json.base_url }}', 10
);
SELECT
  '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::text AS workspace_id,
  '{{ $json.base_url }}'::text     AS base_url,
  {{ $json._start_at }}::bigint    AS _start_at

WITH ins_doc AS (
  INSERT INTO documents (workspace_id, source_type, title, source_url, content)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid, 'website',
    'Website: {{ $json.base_url }}', '{{ $json.source_url }}',
    '{{ $json.content.substring(0,200).replace(/'/g, "''") }}...')
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
),
doc_id AS (
  SELECT id FROM ins_doc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM documents
   WHERE workspace_id = '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid
     AND source_url = '{{ $json.source_url }}' AND source_type = 'website'
   LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO chunks (document_id, workspace_id, chunk_index, content, embedding)
VALUES ((SELECT id FROM doc_id LIMIT 1), '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.chunk_index }}, '{{ $json.content.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.embedding_str }}'::vector)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id::text

INSERT INTO build_events (workspace_id, step, status, message, progress)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::uuid,
  'ready', 'done',
  'Knowledge base ready — {{ $json.chunks_stored }} chunks stored from website.',
  100
)
RETURNING
  '{{ $json.workspace_id }}'::text AS workspace_id,
  {{ $json.chunks_stored }}        AS chunks_stored,
  'done'::text                     AS status
